analysis: The trial crashed: the host reports that train.py exited with status 1 after 40.68 allocated GPU-seconds. The provided traceback is only the subprocess wrapper and does not identify the underlying training error. No validation score was reported, so this trial provides no evidence of improvement over the prior macro HR@10 of 0.5363 or Electronics HR@10 of 0.355. The intended latest-occurrence weighting is implemented, but successful training and predictor agreement remain unverified.
code_summary: MultVAE with a weighted sum EmbeddingBag encoder, 256 hidden units, 64 latent dimensions, dropout 0.5, Gaussian posterior, and tanh decoder. Each unique history item receives weight 2**(-age/10), using its latest occurrence, followed by L2 normalization. Reconstruction targets remain binary unique items. Training retains Adam, KL annealing, four dataset routes, and validation HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. Generated prediction code shares the history transform and uses posterior-mean inference. Deterministic checks cover recency weights, binary targets, empty histories, and validation/predictor score agreement.
